title: Deploying a microservice
text: To deploy a microservice, run unit and integration tests, build a versioned container image, deploy to staging, then use a canary rollout with a rollback plan.

title: Troubleshooting API performance
text: To troubleshoot API performance issues, inspect p95 latency, error rates and traces. Profile slow endpoints and database queries before changing capacity.

title: Data processing workflow implementation
text: Implement a data processing workflow with schema validation, idempotent processing, retries and a dead-letter queue. Test it in staging before release.

title: Rollback procedure
text: Roll back a failed deployment to the previous image version. Verify health checks and error rates before resuming traffic.

title: Engineering log retention note
text: An informal engineering note recommends retaining production API request logs for 90 days for troubleshooting.

title: Capacity changes
text: Use load tests and CPU and memory measurements to decide whether API capacity needs scaling. Define a rollback threshold before changes.

title: Data workflow approvals
text: A new data processing workflow requires approval from the business owner and data owner before implementation. Record both approvals in the change ticket.

title: Budget approval
text: A workflow with new infrastructure spending requires budget approval from the cost centre owner before purchasing capacity.

title: Production change approval
text: A production release requires the service owner to approve the change ticket and rollout window. Emergency releases use the incident commander approval path.

title: Service ownership
text: Every microservice must have a named service owner and an on-call team in the service catalogue. The owner is accountable for business impact.

title: Prioritizing requests
text: Prioritize workflow requests by customer impact, expected benefit and delivery effort. The product owner records the prioritization decision.

title: Vendor procurement
text: A new vendor requires procurement review and a contract approved by the budget owner. This business review is separate from security review.

title: Deployment compliance checks
text: Before deploying a microservice, complete dependency vulnerability scanning, secrets scanning and a security review. Store the compliance checks in the release ticket.

title: Secure API troubleshooting
text: When troubleshooting API performance, redact personal data and credentials from logs, use least-privilege access and never disable production audit logging.

title: Data processing security review
text: Before a data processing workflow goes live, classify the data, perform a privacy impact assessment for personal data and obtain security approval.

title: Production API log retention policy
text: Production API request logs must be deleted after 30 days under the current approved retention policy. This policy takes precedence over informal engineering notes.

title: Access control policy
text: Production access requires least-privilege permissions, multifactor authentication and an auditable approval. Review access quarterly.

title: Encryption policy
text: Encrypt personal data in transit and at rest. Store encryption keys in the approved secrets manager and rotate keys according to the security runbook.
